name: collections: reads beside a reference, an annotation and earlier results become a list:paired, and the rest stays as it was
description: Real histories are not just the files to collect. Four paired reads for two samples and an orphan mate sit beside a reference assembly, a gene annotation and an earlier BED result. The agent must build a list:paired of the two samples and leave everything else visible with its datatype, as Galaxy's collection builders leave a dataset they did not collect. This is where an inferred structure and a broad default scope go wrong: unrelated files outvoting the pairs, or being swept into a collection and hidden.
inputs: My current history has paired-end reads for two samples, along with a reference, a gene annotation and some earlier results. Put the paired reads into a paired collection called "reads" and leave everything else as it is.

*.why: Galaxy's collection tools build lists and list:paired through run_tool (__BUILD_LIST__, __ZIP_COLLECTION__, __APPLY_RULES__).
